claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 197 attendees for this Sports Tournament, in line with turnout at our previous Sports Tournament events.
We can deliver this Sports Tournament efficiently within INR 21,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
